agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, February 22, 2021 - 04:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that pursuant to Government Code Section 54956, by delivery of this written notice as provided by law, the Mayor has called a special meeting of the Lomita City Council. Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20 issued on March 17, 2020, this meeting will be held via teleconference only and no physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided.
Access to the meeting will be available via URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88080563975 or by calling (669) 900 6833 Zoom meeting ID: 880 8056 3975
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Roll Call
2.
PUBLIC COMMENTS Persons wishing to speak on agenda items are requested to do so at this time. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
3.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 MID-YEAR BUDGET AMENDMENTS RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve the recommendations contained in the attached Resolutions and Attachments; and 2) Direct staff to make necessary expenditure and revenue budget adjustments to implement the recommendations.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-04 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A COMPENSATION PLAN FOR NON-REPRESENTED EMPLOYEES FOR FISCAL YEARS 2018-19 TO 2021-22 AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 2018-31
Item SCH 3
4.
ADJOURNMENT I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: February 18, 2021
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
